name: Home Battery Rebate (SGIP)
description: Rebate covering 80-100% of home battery storage for qualifying customers in wildfire/outage-prone areas who are on Medical Baseline, income-qualified, or rely on a well pump; income-qualified Equity rebate is waitlisted
fullDescription: The Self-Generation Incentive Program (SGIP) provides incentives for home battery storage; the Equity Resiliency rebate can cover 80-100% of battery costs for vulnerable households in wildfire and outage-prone areas, and the income-qualified Equity rebate is currently waitlisted.
whatTheyOffer:
- Equity Resiliency rebate: covers 80% to 100% of battery installation cost
- Residential Solar and Storage Equity rebate (income-qualified, up to 100% with federal credits): currently closed; join the waitlist through your contractor
- Backup power during outages
- Can pair with solar
howToGetIt:
1. Equity Resiliency: live in a Tier 2/3 High Fire-Threat District, or have had more than two PSPS outages or 5+ EPSS outages since 2023
2. And be on Medical Baseline, meet income standards, or rely on an electric well pump (or be enrolled in ESA or have SASH/DAC-SASH incentives reserved)
3. Work with an SGIP-approved contractor, who submits the application for you
4. Enroll in a demand response program (Automated Response Technology or SmartRate)
5. Solar customers on older net metering may need to switch to the Solar Billing Plan
keywords: SGIP, battery, solar, Tesla Powerwall, Enphase, backup power, low-income, rebate, self-generation, storage
